## What changed

01

### Eight unused plugins switched off

done

cloudflare, feature-dev, claude-code-setup, skill-creator, context7, firebase, typescript-lsp, php-lsp — flipped to false in ~/.claude/settings.json. The two LSP backends carry a caveat: their usage tracking shipped recently, so a lifetime zero may simply predate it.

02

### Eight idle tool connections disabled

done

Zero calls across every repo in the window. They arrive from /home/ubuntu/.mcp.json, an ancestor file that reaches every project under your home directory — so this turns them off in this repo only.

03

### Auto mode is now the default

done

A safety classifier approves routine actions instead of prompting each time. It was active per-session but never persisted. This cannot lock you out — if auto mode is ever unavailable, the CLI falls back to normal prompting with a notice.

04

### Three read-only commands pre-approved

judgement call

Bash(gh pr view *), Bash(gh pr checks *) and mcp__home-assistant__ha_get_overview. Worth knowing: all ~94 of those denials were you declining at the prompt, not friction from a rule. If those refusals were deliberate, say so and I’ll pull the rules back out.

Worth a decision

Stripe costs more resident context than everything removed, combined — roughly 1,180 est. tokens for a single lifetime use. It survived only because that one use fell inside the window. If Stripe work isn’t ongoing, disabling it is the largest win still on the table.

## Findings without actions

05

### One repo’s hooks are slow — not all of them

warning

The PostToolUse:Edit chain runs at a 2,124 ms median in mylantite across 625 runs, against 164 ms in homeassistant. Same engine, same three hooks, a thirteenfold gap. It tracks repo scale — 3,059 tracked files and a 2.1 MB memory directory versus 170 files — but that is correlation, not a profile.

An earlier read of this called it kit-wide. It isn’t; it is concentrated in one repo, which changes the fix from an engine change to a scaling question.

06

### Resident context is dominated by two files

healthy

The skill listing totals roughly 3.0k est. tokens against a ~1% budget — ample headroom on a 1M-token model, so skill routing is not degrading. CLAUDE.md is 6,053 characters and entirely non-derivable policy: nothing to trim.

07

### The update would not download

blocked

Two attempts, both Download timed out: exceeded the total deadline. Still on 2.1.237. The install is intact — 2.1.234 and 2.1.237 are both present and the launcher resolves correctly — but a zero-byte 2.1.247 stub was left behind and survived the retry, so it may be worth deleting before trying again.
